payload.posture: Read Acts 28:23–31 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states paul remains in rented lodging, welcomes visitors, proclaims God’s Kingdom, and teaches about Jesus with boldness and no hindrance. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: Acts ends with unhindered Kingdom teaching
